label: autologous haematopoietic stem cell transplantation
rationale: Proposed immune reset: high-dose chemotherapy removes the autoreactive immune system, which regrows from the patient's own stem cells; no single molecular target

label: mesenchymal stem cells
rationale: Proposed paracrine immunomodulation and tissue support; no single molecular target

label: tolerogenic dendritic cells
rationale: Proposed antigen-specific tolerance from dendritic cells conditioned to calm rather than prime T cells; no single molecular target

label: T-cell vaccination
rationale: Proposed regulatory response against the patient's own myelin-reactive T cells, given back attenuated; no single molecular target

label: virus-specific T cells
rationale: Proposed killing of EBV-infected B cells by EBV-specific T cells; no human molecular target

label: NK cell therapy
rationale: Proposed depletion of autoreactive immune cells by natural killer cells; no single molecular target

label: immunoglobulin (IVIG / SCIG)
rationale: Proposed broad immunomodulation by pooled human IgG; no single molecular target

label: plasma exchange
rationale: Proposed removal of circulating autoantibodies and other plasma factors; no molecular target

label: immunoadsorption
rationale: Proposed selective removal of circulating immunoglobulin from plasma; no molecular target

label: anti-thymocyte globulin
rationale: Proposed T-cell depletion by polyclonal antibodies against many T-cell surface antigens; no single molecular target

label: myelin peptides
rationale: Proposed tolerance to myelin basic protein by giving its peptides; the antigen is not a drug target

label: acetylcholine receptor peptides
rationale: Proposed tolerance to the acetylcholine receptor by giving its epitopes; the antigen is not a drug target

label: T-cell receptor peptides
rationale: Proposed regulatory response against myelin-reactive T cells by giving peptides of their receptors; no single molecular target

label: helminth therapy
rationale: Proposed shift of immune responses towards regulation by a controlled helminth infection; no single molecular target

label: glatiramer acetate
rationale: Proposed modification of immune processes; the label says the mechanism is not fully understood

label: high-dose biotin
rationale: Proposed activation of biotin-dependent carboxylases for myelin repair and energy supply; not an established target

label: lipoic acid
rationale: Proposed antioxidant effect; no single molecular target

label: gold nanocrystals (CNM-Au8)
rationale: Proposed support of brain cell energy metabolism (NAD+/NADH); no protein target

label: exercise and training
rationale: Proposed benefit of structured physical activity for fitness, mobility and fatigue; no molecular target

label: physiotherapy
rationale: Proposed recovery of movement, balance and function through guided physical therapy; no molecular target

label: cognitive rehabilitation
rationale: Proposed recovery or compensation of cognitive function through structured training; no molecular target

label: robot-assisted training
rationale: Proposed recovery of gait and arm function through repetitive robot- or exoskeleton-assisted practice; no molecular target

label: cognitive behavioural therapy
rationale: Proposed relief of fatigue, mood, pain or sleep problems by changing thoughts and habits; no molecular target

label: mindfulness and meditation
rationale: Proposed relief of stress and mood symptoms through attention training; no molecular target

label: education and self-management
rationale: Proposed better self-management through information and coaching; no molecular target

label: transcranial magnetic stimulation
rationale: Proposed modulation of cortical excitability by magnetic pulses; no molecular target

label: transcranial direct current stimulation
rationale: Proposed modulation of cortical excitability by a weak direct current; no molecular target

label: peripheral nerve and muscle stimulation
rationale: Proposed relief of spasticity, pain, bladder or muscle weakness by electrical stimulation; no molecular target

label: deep brain stimulation
rationale: Proposed tremor control by stimulating deep brain nuclei; no molecular target

label: virtual reality
rationale: Proposed motor and cognitive training in an immersive virtual setting; no molecular target

label: wearables and apps
rationale: Proposed support of activity and symptom tracking by wearable devices; no molecular target

label: diet
rationale: Proposed effect of a dietary pattern (ketogenic, fasting, calorie restriction and others) on inflammation and metabolism; no single molecular target

label: thymectomy
rationale: Proposed removal of the thymus, where acetylcholine receptor autoimmunity is thought to start; no molecular target

label: venous angioplasty (CCSVI)
rationale: Proposed relief of venous outflow narrowing (the CCSVI hypothesis); no molecular target

label: focused ultrasound
rationale: Proposed tremor control by an ultrasound lesion in the thalamus; no molecular target

label: faecal microbiota transplantation
rationale: Proposed reshaping of the gut microbiome that modulates immune responses; no single molecular target

label: acute intermittent hypoxia
rationale: Proposed priming of spinal motor plasticity by brief bouts of low oxygen; no molecular target
